sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety candidates for 2026-06-16 to 2026-06-22; PACMS ranked first among low-duplicate-risk candidates.
Main agent read arXiv metadata, PDF, and HTML full text; extracted the objective, OpenClaw integration, LongMemEval setup, Table 1/2 metrics, failure modes, and reproducibility boundaries.
Article is pure Markdown with 5078 Chinese characters, no frontmatter, no external image embeds, and evidence represented as formulas, tables, pseudocode, and Mermaid.
